25may1601.summary: Aerssen, Dutch agent in Paris, reports to Oldenbarnevelt that the English agent assured him the peace negotiation is being resumed and that {47'} will work to bring the Queen of England to it; the cipher adds that 'he' is implicated in the party of the late {45'} (context: Essex) and in the denunciation of the ambassador Neville, since put in the Tower.
25may1601.en:
the English agent assured me that the peace negotiation is being resumed, and that I must not ⟦doubt the effort of
{47'} to dispose the Queen of England to it and to obtain it by all means⟧. Without wishing to dissect this for me, ⟦he
is nevertheless implicated in the party of the late {45'}⟧, and by the denunciation of the Ambassador Neville, who has
since been put in the Tower.

2jun1601.summary: An 11-token cipher run naming La Bauderie, the King's ambassador at {88'} (context: Brussels), as the source of a report that a Scot named Stadt or Stalwalter keeps regular correspondence with the Archdukes.

snip.cap: 25 May 1601, left page, top: cipher runs within clear French, between “paix; et que ne me doibz” and “sans me vouloir anatomiser ce”.

system: A French syllabic nomenclator mixes numbers and graphic signs for letters, syllables and names, with bars and strokes distinguishing values.
